strings.mdKbSmart: • Ka jingshim ia ka synduk shabi kaba stad: ka peit ia ka synduk shabi ba mynta pyrshah ia ka thup jingpynkylla jong u Google (CRL) bad ka pyrshang ia ki bun tylli ki tyllong haduh ba kan da shem ia ka synduk shabi kaba biang, ryngkat bad ka jingpynkylla thymmai bad ka jingsdang biang ia ki jingshakri Google. Ka iaid ha man la ka tap bad donkam ia ka internet (1-3 minit).
strings.mdKbNet: • Ka keybox na ka network: ka download ia ka keybox na ka jaka buh jingtip ba thikna (GitHub) bad buh ia ka ha ka /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Donkam ia ka internet bad ka shim por 1-3 minit. La pyndonkam haba ka smart fetch ka sniew lane haba la pynkylla ia ka keybox da ka kti.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • Ka jingpeit bniah: ka peit ia ki module jong ka jingpynbiang ia ki shabi ba jngai kiba don, ka peit bniah ia ka dur jong ka jingpynshisha jong ka jingpynshisha, bad ka pyni ia ka jinglong jong ki tiar KmInstallKeybox. Ka jingkylla ei ei — ka jingpeit ia ka jinglong jong ka tiar kaba jem.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Ka jingpeit bniah (tang pule): ka pyni ia ki dak jong ka kyrdan (tang) na ki dumpsys, ka jingdon jong ka DRM (IDM) key-file, bad ki jinglong jong ka system kiba iadei. Ka pynkylla ei ei ruh em.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Ka jingpynbeit ia ka kot: ka pyntreikam ia ka kot. Ka pynbeit ia ki jingeh jong ka jingpynshisha haba ka pass kaba thymmai ka sniew. Man la ka run ka print ia u lain ba shai jong ka jingjop/jingduh.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Ka jingpynbeit ba pura: ka pyntreikam ia ka sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh ba pura. Ka pyniaid ia ki case kiba eh bad ka shim por kham slem. Ka jingmih kaba shai ka paw ha kaba kut.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Pynkylla biang ia ka GMS: ka pynkhuid ia ki data jong ki jingshakri (GMS+GSF) bad ka pynsdang biang ia ka tiar hi dalade. Na ka bynta ka jingpynshisha kaba jemnud tang — kam ju ktah ia ki dur ne ki file jong phi.
strings.mdCertify: • Ka jingpynshisha play: ka peit ia ka jinglong jong ka jingpynshisha RKP jong ka tiar bad pynkylla biang ia ki jinglong jong ka jingpynshisha lada donkam. Ka jingktah ia ki data jong ki nongpyndonkam.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER jingpynbha: pynbeit ia ki jingeh jong ka rukom treikam jong ki jingshakri (SOTER) kiba iadei bad ka jingpynshisha ia ki tiar. La pyndonkam na ka bynta ki katto katne ki tiar kiba shaniah ha ka SOTER ha ka jaka jong ka Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Pyndonkam ia ka bor PIF: pynlong ia ka bor. Ka pyndonkam ia ka dak kti ba la jied (ka jaka/ka jingpynpaw) bad pynthymmai ia ki file pif.prop/pif.json. Ka jingmih kaba shai ka paw ha ka log.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF check: ka pyni ia ka jinglong jong ka engine ba la buh, ki file jong ki dak kti (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), bad ki log. Check tang — kam pynkylla ei ei.
strings.mdCanary: • Ka jingpynkylla: ka pyntreikam ia ka sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Ka shim ia ka jingpynmih ba thymmai jong ka Canary Engine ban pynthikna ia ka jingiadei bad ki jingpynshisha RKP ba donkam (U bnai Thow 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Ka jingpeit bniah ia ka engine: ka peit ia ka jinglong TrickyStoreOSS (pid, security_patch.txt, RKP ki file jong ki shabi (ba treikam pyrshah ia u nongpyndonkam), ia ka dak kti jong ka tiar ba shisha bad kaba la thok, ki shabi. Ka jingpyni ia ka jingpang tang.
